column4: Time intervals distinguish two deaths described with the same formula. Second gloss contains a typo.
Right chamber versus main room; nearly all ritual details coincide.
Relative versus absolute truth.
Sun turning white versus an object appearing in daytime. Second gloss supplies its identity.
The statue and path suggest this order, but sound and low house belong to other narrative steps.
Neither translation describes clemency, learning or the father's appointments.
Return versus blocked travel identify passages. Death and river route are missing or altered.
Obligation and the service of things identify the first. Discussion of customary principles omits the water analogy.
Both mention Liaocheng; duration and losses identify the second. First gloss changes the acting state.
Advice to stay and defend fits; reply of approval does not translate departure.
Outbound versus return visit.
Bowing explains the manner of competition but is a neighboring clause. Prayer after offending heaven matches.
Home and wet weather fit; meeting a fairy does not translate taking two items and turning back.
Torture is unrelated to ten volumes. Explanation of unpublicized institutions fits.
River name is shared with a different episode; stele and burial are unrelated to either sentence.
Neither court music nor the empress's mourning appears in the glosses.
Confusion of the self versus the existence of being and nonbeing.
Drowsiness and pallor versus angry unannounced departure.
Massacre matches; change of era is unrelated to resigning for illness.
The emperor's visit can be identified, but promotion to the seat is missing. Marriage is untranslated.
Angry owner and compensation versus a tour of the warehouse.
General distinction versus genealogy explaining the distinction.
A list of injunctions versus the single rule for military action.
Both candidates concern legitimacy or honors; neither translates the source episodes.
The added explanation of fault distinguishes nearly identical sources.
Addressing ministers is shared but neither diplomatic mission nor excessive leniency is translated.
Neither the posthumous title nor the verse is recovered.
The banner-shaped peak and row of peaks are identifiable. The other gloss omits the cave and dark grotto.
A year being too slow versus succession and the mandate of heaven.
Anger on first meeting versus increasing anger at respectful behavior; sentence boundary shifts.
One gloss blends both posts, the other describes exam ranking. Separate assignments are underdetermined.
Charge and rout match exactly. The other gloss shares defeated multitudes but describes a narrower episode.
Remove dishes and order wine matches. The other gloss provides no ten-year interval.
Both concern self-cultivation, but daily progress and decline are absent from the first. Verse matches the second.
House is shared, entering an empty corridor is missing. Remembering but unable to find them fits.
One translation encompasses both death notices; the other concerns surrender and resettlement.
Rhetorical question versus plain speech in mourning.
Responsibilities match one clause but the defensive works are absent. Archiving is unrelated to guarding steps.
Neither the camel episode nor the first soldier entering is translated.
Hesitation and eventual agreement match. Aspiring to a post is related to the appointment but not the same event.
Same retrieved mirror but a subsequent act. Flying sword is represented only by the final clause.
Both concern administration but neither renders the rank or the office described.
Withdrawal after surprise versus wishing to move to a larger state.
Two distinct death records; both glosses describe other circumstances.
Endorsement of a proposal versus lack of results from deliberation.
Study and ease of action fit partially. The debt statement is unrelated.
Ritual quantities refer to different supplies. The diplomatic greeting matches.
Etiquette and taboos are shared themes but there is no decree about halberds or direct translation of the inscription.
Pressure with the blunt needle matches. Filiform needle is unrelated to the distribution of qi in vessels.
Examiner refuses versus criticism and loss of career prospects.
Neither recommendation nor the specified factional promotions are rendered.
Both glosses concern honors or excess of Liang Ji, unrelated to Ban Gu or the listed offices.
Departure to office and restored station match. Renting the house is a different line of the same inquiry.
Anger versus worry and stored provisions.
Dried meat and paste shared with the ritual offering, but no counters or unmatched remainder.
Nearly interchangeable questions; the shorter modern why does not isolate the added classical word.
Conditional escape from death versus missing snake and horse after clouds clear.
Lending troops versus immediate disaster if troops depart.
Neither appointment in Eastern Yuzhou nor the specific canal mouth is translated.
Admonition is linked weakly to the first; the second has only a fragment of the song.
Neither illness gloss renders the short sources; context would be needed.
Dislike for greed versus feeding plain food because the lord appeared to slight the guest.
Empress appointment is missing. The death of Shouan is identifiable.
Wife taking property during illness versus the elapsed days on returning home.
